_comment: Te Manawa kiosk shell settings. Keep this file beside TeManawa.exe. Keys starting with _ are notes. Run `TeManawa.exe --displays` to list the displays with their index numbers.
_port: The local server's port. If it is taken the shell uses any free port (the two pages still find each other).
_display: 'largest' / 'smallest' / 'primary' / a display index from --displays / 'other' (console only: the display the wall is not on) / 'none' (no console).
_query: Extra URL options for a page, e.g. the wall's "render=2d" to force the 2D renderer, or "terrain=square". Normally empty.
_relaunchHour: The whole program restarts at five past this hour every night (the pages reload themselves on the hour). null turns it off.
_ignoreGpuBlocklist: If the debug overlay's PERF panel says '2D canvas' instead of 'WebGL', try true: it forces GPU rendering on a graphics card Chromium has blocklisted.
